description: This file implements a driver for the Nordic nRF5 RNG hardware, managing entropy generation, buffering, and interrupt handling for energy-efficient random number generation in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: random_byte_get
methods.description: Reads a random byte from the NRF RNG hardware if available.

methods.name: rng_pool_get
methods.description: Retrieves bytes from the RNG pool buffer, managing buffer indices and triggering RNG hardware as needed.

methods.name: rng_pool_put
methods.description: Stores a byte into the RNG pool buffer, handling buffer full condition.

methods.name: rng_pool_init
methods.description: Initializes the RNG pool buffer with size and threshold.

methods.name: isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for handling RNG hardware events, storing generated bytes into buffers.

methods.name: entropy_nrf5_get_entropy
methods.description: Provides entropy bytes to requesting components, managing buffer access and synchronization.

methods.name: entropy_nrf5_get_entropy_isr
methods.description: Provides entropy bytes via ISR, optionally busy-waiting for RNG hardware readiness.

methods.name: entropy_nrf5_init
methods.description: Initializes the RNG driver, setting up semaphores, buffers, and hardware interrupts.
